P-15.title: Two Teams, One Road
hints: A return reserve belongs in the departure plan.
Marker2 is part of the radio path.
Use surveyed route, restore buoy 2, home heatMIN/lampDIM/returnOPEN.
P-15.mastery: Both ledgers safe, rover reserve at least 2, no blackout, marker two restored and the chain tested.

first_time_card.title: Two teams, one road
first_time_card.purpose: Plan the whole trip, not just the way out.
steps: Read the journey card and the manifest.
Choose a road the rover can actually drive.
Keep the return in the battery.

P-16.title: The Link and the Living Garden
hints: Connect Aurora’s repeater chain before Earth.
L2 thenE3, checksumALO42, verify both voices; return and open the safe shutter.
P-16.mastery: Both links pass on their own evidence, the echo comes back exactly, everyone is home and the five sunrise checks pass.

first_time_card.title: Both ends of the light
first_time_card.purpose: A relay works only when every link passes its own test.
steps: Isolate, test zero, replace, close, reconnect.
Lock the road chain first, then Earth.

EX-CH08-S01.goal: Assign two teams and pack the rover
EX-CH08-S01.why: Nobody appears at the summit because the story needs them.

clues.text: The journey card on the departure board: 24 h out, 3 h repair, 24 h back.
Independent supplies for the trip.

Ferreira on the road ahead.

Kai on the departure budget.

EX-CH08-S04.goal: Restore marker two and test both neighbours
EX-CH08-S04.why: Lit means powered. A light is not yet a link.

clues.text: The repeater's service drawing and battery specification.
Suit readiness and the tether point.

Kai on finishing the job.
Terrain and the Moon's curve block direct line of sight near the south pole; relays fix it.

EX-CH08-S05.title: Two at Home
EX-CH08-S05.story_date: 8 April 2047 · 18:00 · start of the 36-hour night · Aurora garden
EX-CH08-S05.goal: Set the home loop and forecast the night
EX-CH08-S05.why: Home demand changes when people actually arrive.

clues.text: The same independent gauge that exposed the misleading leak reading in the quake, read calmly.
The home loop: heat MIN (the COOL profile), lamp DIM, water return OPEN.
The occupancy forecast: two for 33 hours, then five for 3 hours.
Amara and Mei on this night.
Two at home.
NASA plans about 0.9 kg of oxygen per person per day: in Aurora's units 0.5 air per 7.2 h for two people, 1.25 for five.

EX-CH08-S05.aha: Then five for the last three hours.
EX-CH08-S05.wrong_idea: Two occupants for the whole night forgets the returning three. Return CLOSED does not fail silently: it shows a thirst forecast.
flight_rules: FR-02 · Air margin: breathing is 0.5 air per 7.2 h for two people and 1.25 for five.
FR-01 · Crew first, station second, science third.

risk.title: Home forecast counts the wrong people

EX-CH08-S05.set_piece: The Sun leaves at the scenario gate. Mei straightens one crooked nameplate and leaves the guide light where it was planned.

EX-CH08-S06.goal: Check home first, then accept the fresh packet

clues.text: Amara's order of work.
Mei on what a packet carries.
Two packets on the console: an older approach packet and a new summit packet, each with sender, position and time.
Rafi's arrival call.
Amara's acknowledgement.

Compare it with the newest position you know.

EX-CH08-S07.title: The Spare Has a History
EX-CH08-S07.story_date: 9 April 2047 · 00:00 to 00:45 · Malapert relay service bay
EX-CH08-S07.why: Correct parts and correct procedure are separate requirements.

clues.text: The crate with Kai's December note; the actual connectors and serial checked again at the point of use.
Ferreira's question before anything moves.
Kai's read-back.
Rafi on the tether and the door.
Kai on the housing.

EX-CH08-S08.title: A Lighthouse Needs Both Shores
EX-CH08-S08.story_date: 9 April 2047 · 00:45 to 01:45 · local antenna and Earth dish
EX-CH08-S08.goal: Lock the road chain, then Earth
EX-CH08-S08.why: A relay is useful only when both legs pass on their own evidence.

clues.text: Kai's order of work.
Two signal panels, each pairing strength with an obstruction reading. Local presets: 1 poor, 2 good, 3 blocked. Earth presets: 1 poor, 2 blocked, 3 good.

Scenario bearings, labelled Computed with no terrain: from Mons Malapert on 9 April 00:45 to 01:45 Earth sits at azimuth 357.9° to 358.0°, elevation −2.3°; the summit sees over the curve from 1.4 km up.
The Aurora Earth-set handover window: a planned deadline with an untimed equivalent.
Rafi on the road chain.
Ferreira on the Earth leg.
Kai on both shores.

EX-CH08-S08.aha: Both shores, not just the bright one.
EX-CH08-S08.wrong_idea: Point at Earth first because Earth is the goal: the local leg must pass on its own first, or Aurora still has no checked path to the summit.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Protected power: isolate and verify zero before touching a live controller; never reconnect with the housing open.

risk.title: Earth leg strong, local leg unverified

EX-CH08-S08.set_piece: Pressure without motor timing: the handover window counts down, and the dials answer with strength and obstruction, never a buzzer.

EX-CH08-S09.title: Forty-Two Comes Back Correctly
EX-CH08-S09.goal: Send the test phrase and accept only the exact reply
EX-CH08-S09.why: A strong signal can still carry wrong content.

clues.text: Rafi on strength.
The diagnostic preview holds three replies: an exact current match, a near match and an older saved packet.
Kai's report.
Amara's telemetry packet, with the station clock and the five-person return plan attached.
Ferreira on what comes next.
Two backlogs cross on the data panel: Aurora's outbox, queued for Earth since the blackout, finally sends; Rao's listening log arrives, one line every few hours for fifty-two days.

EX-CH08-S09.aha: Strong is not the same as correct.
EX-CH08-S09.wrong_idea: Accept a similar-looking or older reply: it fails the exact-current-match rule.
flight_rules: FR-04 · Protected power: isolate and verify zero before touching a live controller; never reconnect with the housing open.
EX-CH08-S09.set_piece: The returned characters A-L-O-4-2 settle beside the sent string one by one.

Amara on gardeners.

EX-CH08-S12.title: What We Grew
EX-CH08-S12.story_date: 10 April 2047 · 06:00 · first light · Aurora pressurised garden
EX-CH08-S12.goal: Pass five checks, then open the shutter

Mei's reading.
Amara's reading.
Ferreira at the window.

p15_confirm_teams.title: Two boards, five names
p15_confirm_teams.goal: Put three names on the rover board and two on home
p15_confirm_teams.why: Nobody appears at the summit because the story needs another speaker.

feedback.mei_on_rover: Mei has the garden. Only the home team can run the care round and the home loop.
feedback.amara_on_rover: Amara reads the independent gauge at home. Without her, the home checks have no measurement.
feedback.seats: Three travel and two keep Aurora. The rover has three seats and the garden needs two pairs of hands.

p15_confirm_loadout.title: Open crates against the manifest
p15_confirm_loadout.goal: Pack only what the signed manifest lists
p15_confirm_loadout.why: A missing spare blocks departure. An incompatible spare rides for nothing.

items.label: Compatible relay controller
items.detail: Kai's December note: connector and serial match the Malapert housing.

items.label: Relay service diagram
items.detail: The housing, the isolator and the two antenna channels.

items.label: Three repeater checkpoints
items.detail: Surveyed pads for markers one, two and three.

items.label: 2034 controller from the old housing
items.detail: Damaged. Its connector does not match the December spare's.

items.label: Decorative flood lamps
items.detail: Removed from the eclipse plan. They would ride on the return reserve.

feedback.missing: Something on the signed manifest is still in the bay. Departure waits.
feedback.forbidden: That crate is not on the manifest. A damaged unit or a decorative load spends reserve for nothing.

p15_confirm_roundtrip_provisions.title: Supplies for the whole trip
p15_confirm_roundtrip_provisions.goal: Choose how many hours of independent supplies to carry
p15_confirm_roundtrip_provisions.why: Arrival is not the end of the journey.

options.label: 24 hours
options.detail: Enough for the outward leg only.
options.feedback: The return and the repair hours are missing. Twenty-four out, three repair, twenty-four back: departure waits.

options.label: 27 hours
options.detail: Outward leg plus the repair window.
options.feedback: That covers the summit but not the road home. Return is part of the mission.

options.label: 51 hours
options.detail: Exactly the round trip: 24 + 3 + 24.
options.advisory: Exactly 51 hours leaves no margin. The rover carries 72; use the margin.

options.label: 72 hours
options.detail: The whole 51-hour plan with margin.

p15_choose_surveyed_route.title: Which road can be committed?
p15_choose_surveyed_route.goal: Pick the road, then mark the battery that must stay unavailable
p15_choose_surveyed_route.why: Optimise only inside the safety limits.

routes.label: Shorter steep shortcut
routes.feedback: Route rejected by the flight rule: a 22° slope is above the rover's 15° limit. A reserve cannot rescue an impossible road.

routes.label: Surveyed road
routes.detail: 5 units out, 5 back, 12° at the steepest.

reserve.label: Battery kept for the return and the minimum

feedback.reserve_low: That leaves less than the 2-unit minimum. The return stays in the departure budget.
feedback.reserve_high: The battery cannot keep more than what the round trip leaves. Subtract both legs first.

p15_confirm_return_reserve.title: Reconcile the reserve
p15_confirm_return_reserve.goal: Work out what the battery holds after the return
p15_confirm_return_reserve.why: The arithmetic is the plan: battery, minus out, minus back.
p15_confirm_return_reserve.formula: energy minus the outward allowance minus the return allowance

feedback.wrong: That is not what the battery holds after both legs. Subtract the outward allowance and the return allowance from the battery.
feedback.low: Below the 2-unit minimum: the plan is not safe to commit.

p15_reach_marker_two.title: Match the marker to the map
p15_reach_marker_two.goal: Turn the bearing dial until the marker and the map agree
p15_reach_marker_two.why: The black sky and long shadows give scale, not a compass.

presets.label: Steer toward the tall silhouette
presets.obstruction: Not on the surveyed line. A silhouette is not a reference.

feedback.off: The marker and the map disagree at that bearing. Match the marker, not the silhouette.

p15_set_brake.title: What does a dark marker justify?
p15_set_brake.goal: Decide what to do at the dark marker
p15_set_brake.why: A stable service point permits a bounded diagnosis.

options.label: Leave the road for the visible bypass
options.detail: It looks shorter than the dark pad.
options.feedback: The terrain overlay shows an unsupported cliff route. Off-road driving meets a slope barrier; return to the last marker.

options.label: Brake in the known service zone
options.detail: Stop on the surveyed pad and set the brake.

p15_save_position_packet.title: Send the position packet
p15_save_position_packet.goal: Choose the packet that tells Aurora where you are now
p15_save_position_packet.why: A packet needs a sender, a position and a time.

options.label: Resend the stored packet
options.detail: Sent from marker one earlier on the road.
options.feedback: That packet says where you were, not where you are. Aurora could not tell it from a stored update.

options.label: Send a new packet
options.detail: Marker two pad, brake set, now.

p15_restore_marker_2.title: Repeater procedure card
p15_restore_marker_2.goal: Do the six steps in order
p15_restore_marker_2.why: Power isolated before the battery. No bare-handed repair in vacuum.

steps.label: Compare the spare with the specification
steps.verify: Voltage and connector match the drawing.

distractors.label: Re-seat the dead battery
distractors.feedback: That battery is the fault. The packed spare matches the specification; the dead one does not light anything.

distractors.label: Reconnect with the housing open
distractors.feedback: Held: the housing must be closed before power returns.

feedback.order: Held: the procedure names the missing condition. Do the previous step first.
feedback.unbraked: An unbraked exterior repair cannot start. Set the brake on the pad first.

p15_test_repeater_chain.title: The marker lights. What completes verification?
p15_test_repeater_chain.goal: Test what the marker must do, not what it looks like
p15_test_repeater_chain.why: A bright indicator can mean local power without proving a link.

items.label: The marker is lit: call the chain working

feedback.missing: Lit means powered. Test both neighbours.
feedback.forbidden: A light is not yet a link. Run the two adjacent-link tests before calling the chain working.

p15_reach_approach.title: Continue to marker three
p15_reach_approach.goal: Confirm the chain and drive on to the 100-kilometre approach
p15_reach_approach.why: The final twenty kilometres stay on the route schedule.
p15_reach_approach.readback: Three repeater sites verified. Field team reaches the 100-kilometre approach at 17:00; a time card holds the field position while control returns to Aurora.

p15_confirm_home_occupancy.title: Which home forecast matches the signed journey?
p15_confirm_home_occupancy.goal: Choose how to count the people at home tonight
p15_confirm_home_occupancy.why: Consumption follows the actual people and the moment they arrive.

options.label: Two occupants for the whole night
options.detail: Mei and Amara for 36 hours.
options.feedback: It omits the returning three during the final hours. Then five for the last three hours.

options.label: Five occupants for the whole night
options.detail: Count everyone from the start.
options.feedback: Three of them breathe rover air until 03:00 on 10 April. Counting them at home all night over-spends the forecast.

options.label: Two for 33 hours, then five for 3 hours
options.detail: The transition matches the dated roster.

p15_confirm_segment_forecast.title: Set the home loop and predict the air
p15_confirm_segment_forecast.goal: Set heat, lamp and water return, then predict the night's air use
p15_confirm_segment_forecast.why: Predict before you test the schedule.

options.label: COZY
options.cost: 2 battery per shift · no cold damage

options.label: OPEN
options.cost: water flows back to the garden

fields.label: Air used over the whole night (predict)

options.cost: 0.5 per shift × 5 shifts: two people all night
1.25 per shift × 5 shifts: five people all night

feedback.heat: The 36-hour night runs 5 shifts: COZY would spend 15 battery on heat alone, and OFF freezes the garden. MIN holds the garden at 1 per shift.
feedback.light: DIM keeps the plants steady at 1 battery per shift; FULL spends the night's margin and OFF costs the garden.
feedback.water_return: Thirst forecast: with the return CLOSED the garden dries while the wall holds water nobody needs tonight. Open the return.
feedback.air_total: Air follows the people: 0.5 per shift for 33 hours, then 1.25 for 3 hours. Add the two parts.

p15_confirm_home_pressure.title: Verify pressure independently
p15_confirm_home_pressure.goal: Choose the reading that verifies the garden's pressure
p15_confirm_home_pressure.why: The panel once showed a misleading leak. The gauge did not.

options.label: Trust the panel indication
options.detail: The console summary says stable.
options.feedback: The panel is a diagnosis, not a measurement. In the quake it was wrong; the independent gauge was right.

options.label: Read the independent gauge
options.detail: 100 relative units, steady over five readings.

p15_confirm_home_checks.title: Home checks first
p15_confirm_home_checks.goal: Run the home checks in order before any acknowledgement
p15_confirm_home_checks.why: A working relay later cannot repair a neglected home now.

p15_confirm_summit.title: Which packet can certify arrival?
p15_confirm_summit.goal: Pick the packet that proves the summit was reached
p15_confirm_summit.why: Evidence must be current enough for the decision it supports.

options.label: The earlier approach packet
options.detail: Stored on the console since 17:00.
options.feedback: Its location and time cannot prove summit arrival. Compare it with the newest position you know.

options.label: The new summit packet
options.detail: Sender, position and time match the planned 24-hour leg.

p15_receive_summit_packet.title: Acknowledge the current packet
p15_receive_summit_packet.goal: Send the acknowledgement that belongs to the current packet
p15_receive_summit_packet.why: A stale acknowledgement would mislead the other team.

options.label: Acknowledge the stored approach packet
options.detail: It is already on the console.
options.feedback: That acknowledgement answers an old question. Accept the packet whose sender, position and time match the planned arrival.

options.label: Acknowledge the current arrival packet
options.detail: Three aboard, summit, 00:00.

p16_isolate_power.title: Which action is safe before removal?
p16_isolate_power.goal: Choose the first command on the housing
p16_isolate_power.why: The sequence blocks removal until isolation and zero are verified.

options.label: Reset the damaged controller while live
options.detail: The reset control is right there.
options.feedback: A reset cannot certify a safe replacement. Removal stays blocked until isolation and zero are verified.

options.label: Isolate relay power
options.detail: Open the isolator first.

p16_zero_test.title: Verify zero
p16_zero_test.goal: Read the meter before touching the controller
p16_zero_test.why: Having the correct spare does not remove electrical hazards.

options.label: Skip the meter: the isolator is open
options.detail: The switch position is proof enough.
options.feedback: A switch position is not a measurement. Verify zero at the point of work.

options.label: Meter reads 0.0 A
options.detail: Isolated. Zero verified.

p16_install_controller.title: Which spare goes in?
p16_install_controller.goal: Check serial and connector at the point of use

options.label: The 2034 unit from the housing
options.detail: Already seated once.
options.feedback: That is the damaged controller. Its serial is the fault record, not the spare.

options.label: Bench unit with the other connector
options.detail: It tested fine on the bench in March.
options.feedback: A bench pass is not field verification. The connector does not match this housing.

options.label: The December spare
options.detail: Kai's note: connector and serial match the Malapert housing.

p16_close_housing.title: Close before reconnecting
p16_close_housing.goal: Decide what happens before power returns
p16_close_housing.why: Reconnecting with the housing open is blocked.

options.label: Reconnect now, close later
options.detail: Save a minute on the handover window.
options.feedback: Blocked: closed before reconnecting. The housing protects the connector in vacuum.

options.label: Close and latch the housing
options.detail: Latch indicator closed.

p16_restore_power.title: Restore power
p16_restore_power.goal: Close the isolator and watch the antenna panel wake
p16_restore_power.readback: Isolate → zero → replace → close → power. The antenna panel wakes with two unverified channels.

p16_local_bearing.title: Lock the road chain
p16_local_bearing.goal: Turn the local dials until the signal panel reads good with no obstruction
p16_local_bearing.why: Aurora first. An image of Earth above a ridge cannot prove that Aurora is audible.

presets.label: Preset 1
presets.obstruction: Signal poor: the first repeater sits behind the near ridge from here.

presets.label: Preset 3
presets.obstruction: Obstructed: terrain between the dish and the road chain.

feedback.off: No signal at that bearing. Try a preset or turn toward the road chain.

p16_earth_bearing.title: Now the Earth leg
p16_earth_bearing.goal: Turn the Earth dish until strength is good and the obstruction reading is clear
p16_earth_bearing.why: Strength alone is not enough when the path stays obstructed.

presets.label: Preset 1
presets.obstruction: Signal poor: Earth sits low; this bearing misses it.

presets.label: Preset 2
presets.obstruction: Obstructed: strong, but the northern hills block the path. Check obstruction too.

feedback.off: No signal at that bearing. Earth is almost due north and about 2.3° below a flat horizon.

p16_earth_bearing.prerequisite_text: Aurora first. Lock the local leg before the Earth dish.

p16_stable_lock.title: Hold a stable lock
p16_stable_lock.goal: Hold both locks for 3 seconds, or tap to confirm
p16_stable_lock.why: Both legs locked and stable before the handover window closes.

lock.window_label: Aurora Earth-set handover window: 01:45. Untimed equivalent: tap to confirm with assistance on.

p16_checksum.title: Which reply passes the content check?
p16_checksum.goal: Send the test phrase and pick the reply that is exact and current
p16_checksum.why: A signal meter can be strong while content arrives wrong.

options.label: A L 0 4 2 · strong · current
options.detail: Strength 5 of 5. One character differs.
options.feedback: Rejected: the third character is a zero, not the letter O. Strong is not the same as correct.

options.label: A L O 4 2 · strong · older saved packet
options.detail: Exact text from yesterday's bench test.
options.feedback: Rejected: the acknowledgement belongs to an old test, not this one. Exact and current, or not at all.

options.label: A L O 4 2 · good · current
options.detail: Exact match, this test.

p16_confirm_path_records.title: Save both path records
p16_confirm_path_records.why: The network is useful when you can show where the information went.

items.label: Local path: Aurora → three repeaters → summit

feedback.missing: Both records, or the relay is only half a lighthouse.

p16_voice_verification_ready.title: What stands in for a conversation?
p16_voice_verification_ready.goal: Decide whether the data echo closes the test
p16_voice_verification_ready.why: Connectivity and correct delivery need separate verification.

options.label: The echo is enough: skip the voice checks
options.detail: Data went and came back.
options.feedback: A data echo does not stand in for a conversation. Now verify the voices at both ends.

options.label: Keep both voice checks as explicit next steps
options.detail: Aurora, then Earth.

p16_noor_live_voice.title: Two voice checks, then transmit
p16_noor_live_voice.goal: Confirm Aurora's voice, then Earth's, then open the channel
p16_noor_live_voice.why: Leave pauses for the 2.6-second round trip.

steps.label: Voice check: Aurora
steps.verify: Mei and Amara heard clearly over the road chain.

steps.label: Voice check: Earth
steps.verify: Rao answers after the light-time pause.

distractors.label: Transmit before the checks
distractors.feedback: The transmit control waits until both path checks are visible.

feedback.order: Aurora first, then Earth. The checks are separate on purpose.

p16_confirm_telemetry.title: Which report describes the achievement?
p16_confirm_telemetry.goal: Choose the report sentence and send the garden telemetry

options.label: The relay crew alone saved the garden
options.detail: Three people on a mountain fixed everything.
options.feedback: The checked record shows the home care and the earlier work that made this possible. The garden has more than one gardener.

options.label: Both teams and earlier work kept the expedition connected
options.detail: Preparation, repair and ongoing care, all named.

p16_start_return.title: Read back the return departure
p16_start_return.goal: Confirm the departure time Rafi reads

options.label: Leave now, 02:15
options.detail: Every minute on the summit spends supplies.
options.feedback: The plan says 03:00: the call finishes and the cabin is sealed first. Read back the time on the card.

options.label: Return starts 03:00, 9 April
options.detail: As planned: 24 hours to Aurora.

p16_confirm_return_24h.title: Three route gates, new timestamps
p16_confirm_return_24h.goal: At each gate, accept the current return packet
p16_confirm_return_24h.why: A stale outward timestamp is not a homebound position.

feedback.missing: Same road, new timestamps. Confirm all three return gates.
feedback.forbidden: That timestamp is from the outward leg. It cannot confirm a homebound position.

p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.title: Arrival check
p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.goal: Verify the three returning names and the pressure procedure
p16_confirm_five_at_aurora.why: The airlock does not open because a cinematic needs a reunion.

feedback.missing: Three arrivals expected and checked, and the pressure procedure before the door.
feedback.forbidden: Noor is on the restored screen, not in the airlock.

p16_update_occupancy.title: When should home consumption increase?
p16_update_occupancy.goal: Choose the moment the base ledger changes
p16_update_occupancy.why: Consumption belongs to the place actually supporting each person.

options.label: When the rover leaves the summit
options.detail: They are coming home, so count them now.
options.feedback: Those people are still supplied by the rover. The base ledger changes at the actual location transition.

options.label: When the three physically return at 03:00
options.detail: Five home. Three hours to first light.

p16_save_final_records.title: Five checks before the shutter
p16_save_final_records.goal: Tick each check against its actual reading
p16_save_final_records.why: Dawn reveals the garden; it does not create it.

checks.label: Founder reserve 30 and eleven vault specimens protected

feedback.missing: The shutter waits for its safety checks. Tick every one against its reading.

p16_save_photo.title: Frame the shared photograph
p16_save_photo.goal: Choose the frame for the photograph
p16_save_photo.why: Everyone who kept the light is in it.

options.label: By the window
options.detail: Cotton in Tara's bay, the descendants in flower.

options.label: At the lineage board
options.detail: Alo's petal, Tara's nameplate, both names.

p16_save_dedication.title: Choose a dedication
p16_save_dedication.goal: Pick the dedication the completed evidence supports
p16_save_dedication.why: It is engraved on the lineage board and shown in the credits.

options.label: For every hand that kept the light
options.detail: The photo credits the whole linked expedition.

payload.dedication: For every hand that kept the light

options.label: For the gardens we leave for others
options.detail: The lineage record connects care across generations.

payload.dedication: For the gardens we leave for others

p16_make_credits_available.title: Complete the credits
p16_make_credits_available.why: Continue returns to the safe completed garden.
p16_make_credits_available.readback: Final records, photo and dedication saved. Credits name both teams and the people who made their first chance possible.
